description: Add LRU eviction (bounded capacity) plus per-entry TTL expiry to an unbounded cache
prompts: Create src/Cache.php defining namespace App and class Cache with a constructor __construct(int $capacity, int $ttl) - a max size and a time-to-live in seconds. put(string $key, $value, int $now): void stores a value timestamped at $now. get(string $key, int $now) returns the value if present AND not expired ($now - storedAt < $ttl), else null - and an expired entry must be REMOVED the moment it's observed to be stale. Both get and put must refresh a key's recency. When put() would exceed $capacity, evict the LEAST recently used entry (recency = most recent get OR put) before inserting the new one.

reference_solution.src/Cache.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class Cache
{
    private int $capacity;
    private int $ttl;
    private array $store = []; // key -> ['value' => ..., 'storedAt' => ...]

    public function __construct(int $capacity, int $ttl)
    {
        $this->capacity = $capacity;
        $this->ttl = $ttl;
    }

    public function put(string $key, $value, int $now): void
    {
        if (array_key_exists($key, $this->store)) {
            unset($this->store[$key]);
        } elseif (count($this->store) >= $this->capacity) {
            $oldestKey = array_key_first($this->store);
            unset($this->store[$oldestKey]);
        }
        $this->store[$key] = ['value' => $value, 'storedAt' => $now];
    }

    public function get(string $key, int $now)
    {
        if (!array_key_exists($key, $this->store)) {
            return null;
        }
        $entry = $this->store[$key];
        if ($now - $entry['storedAt'] >= $this->ttl) {
            unset($this->store[$key]);
            return null;
        }
        unset($this->store[$key]);
        $this->store[$key] = $entry;
        return $entry['value'];
    }
}

test_setup_files.tests/CacheTest.php:
<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/Cache.php';

final class CacheTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testCapacityEvictsLeastRecentlyUsed(): void
    {
        $c = new \App\Cache(2, 1000);
        $c->put("a", 1, 0);
        $c->put("b", 2, 1);
        $c->get("a", 2);
        $c->put("c", 3, 3);
        $this->assertSame(1, $c->get("a", 4));
        $this->assertNull($c->get("b", 4));
        $this->assertSame(3, $c->get("c", 4));
    }

    public function testGetRefreshesRecency(): void
    {
        $c = new \App\Cache(2, 1000);
        $c->put("a", 1, 0);
        $c->put("b", 2, 1);
        $c->get("a", 2);
        $c->get("b", 3);
        $c->put("c", 3, 4);
        $this->assertNull($c->get("a", 5));
        $this->assertSame(2, $c->get("b", 5));
    }

    public function testTtlExpiryIndependentOfCapacity(): void
    {
        $c = new \App\Cache(5, 10);
        $c->put("a", 1, 0);
        $this->assertSame(1, $c->get("a", 9));
        $this->assertNull($c->get("a", 10));
    }
}
